tagline.en: Lafayette to Shreveport, the first piece of a longer idea
tagline.zh: 从拉法耶特到什里夫波特，一个更大构想的第一段

mileageSource: FHWA Route Log and Finder List, Table 1, January 2026

start.zh: 路易斯安那州拉法耶特，与 I-10 相接

end.en: The Arkansas state line north of Shreveport, Louisiana
end.zh: 路易斯安那州什里夫波特以北的阿肯色州界

en: I-49 in Louisiana links the state's two east–west Interstates, running north from I-10 at Lafayette to I-20 at Shreveport and on to the Arkansas line. It follows the older US 71 corridor and serves Opelousas, Alexandria, Natchitoches and Shreveport — a line of towns along the Red River valley that had no fast north–south connection before it.

It is a young road by Interstate standards. Construction did not begin until 1978, more than twenty years after the programme started, and the main length was not finished until the middle of the 1990s. It shows in the geometry: wide medians, generous curves, and long rural stretches with few interchanges.

The number does not stop in Louisiana. I-49 continues in Arkansas and Missouri as parts of a longer corridor intended to run from Kansas City to New Orleans, but those sections are separate roads with gaps between them.
zh: 路易斯安那境内的 I-49 把该州两条东西向州际公路连了起来：自拉法耶特的 I-10 向北，经什里夫波特的 I-20，再通到阿肯色州界。它沿着较早的 US 71 走廊，服务奥珀卢瑟斯、亚历山德里亚、纳基托什和什里夫波特——红河谷沿线一串在此之前没有快速南北通道的城镇。
按州际公路的标准，它是条年轻的路。工程直到 1978 年才开工，比整个计划启动晚了二十多年，主体路段到 1990 年代中期才完成。这一点在线形上看得出来：中央分隔带宽阔、曲线舒缓，乡村路段漫长而出入口稀少。
这个编号并未止步于路易斯安那。I-49 在阿肯色和密苏里继续存在，属于一条意在连接堪萨斯城与新奥尔良的更长走廊，但那些路段彼此之间尚有缺口。

en: The Lafayette–Shreveport link was approved by the Federal Highway Administration in the mid-1970s as a 212-mile route. Construction began in 1978, and the first signed piece opened in July 1982, running with US 167 from I-10 to US 190 at Opelousas. A 32-mile segment finished in 1984 was the first stretch of I-49 anywhere in the country.

Most of the rural mileage opened in the late 1980s, and the route was completed on 1 May 1996 when a 16.6-mile section through Alexandria, named the Martin Luther King Jr. Highway, was finished. The last piece into Shreveport, from the Inner Loop Expressway north to I-20, had opened the previous December.

By then the project had outgrown itself. Congress listed a Kansas City–New Orleans corridor as a high priority in the Intermodal Surface Transportation Efficiency Act of 1991 and it was later specified as I-49, which turned a state connector into the middle section of a national route. Louisiana opened the extension north from Shreveport toward the Arkansas line in 2018; the segment south from Lafayette to New Orleans is still being planned.
zh: 拉法耶特至什里夫波特的连接线于 1970 年代中期获联邦公路管理局批准，全长 212 英里。工程 1978 年开工，第一段挂牌路段 1982 年 7 月通车，与 US 167 共线，自 I-10 至奥珀卢瑟斯的 US 190。1984 年建成的一段 32 英里道路，是全美最早建成的 I-49 路段。
大部分乡村里程在 1980 年代末通车，整条路线于 1996 年 5 月 1 日随着亚历山德里亚境内 16.6 英里、命名为「马丁·路德·金大道」的路段完工而贯通。进入什里夫波特的最后一段——自内环快速路北至 I-20——已于上一年 12 月通车。
到那时，这个项目已经超出了它自己的范围。国会在 1991 年《多式联运地面运输效率法》中把一条堪萨斯城—新奥尔良走廊列为高优先级，后来明确编为 I-49，于是一条州内连接线变成了一条全国性路线的中段。路易斯安那 2018 年开通了自什里夫波特向北通往阿肯色州界的延伸段；自拉法耶特南下至新奥尔良的路段仍在规划中。

label.zh: 路易斯安那在 I-49 项目上的支出

value.en: About $1.5 billion spent to date on I-49-related projects, with roughly $5.6 billion of further work outstanding south of Lafayette and north of Shreveport
value.zh: 迄今在 I-49 相关项目上支出约 15 亿美元，拉法耶特以南与什里夫波特以北另有约 56 亿美元的工程尚待完成

figures.source: Missouri Department of Transportation, Interstate 49 history press kit

value.en: 249.93 miles in Louisiana; the same route log lists a further 127.40 miles in Arkansas and 177.98 in Missouri
value.zh: 路易斯安那州内 249.93 英里；同一份路线名录另列阿肯色州 127.40 英里、密苏里州 177.98 英里

figures.source: FHWA Route Log and Finder List, Table 1, January 2026

value.en: 212 miles from I-10 at Lafayette to I-20 at Shreveport, approved in the mid-1970s and completed in 1996
value.zh: 自拉法耶特的 I-10 至什里夫波特的 I-20 全长 212 英里，1970 年代中期获批，1996 年建成

figures.source: Missouri Department of Transportation, Interstate 49 history press kit

why.en: No agency publishes a route-wide figure. The Louisiana Department of Transportation and Development counts traffic by segment, and volumes on this route range from urban approaches at Lafayette and Shreveport to long rural stretches along the Red River valley.
why.zh: 没有机构发布全线数字。路易斯安那州交通与开发部按路段统计交通量，本路线的流量从拉法耶特与什里夫波特的城市进出段，到红河谷沿线漫长的乡村路段，差异很大。

timeline.en: Construction begins on the Lafayette–Shreveport route, more than twenty years after the Interstate programme started.
timeline.zh: 拉法耶特至什里夫波特路线开工，距州际公路计划启动已过去二十多年。

timeline.en: The first signed segment opens in July, running with US 167 from I-10 to US 190 at Opelousas.
timeline.zh: 7 月第一段挂牌路段通车，与 US 167 共线，自 I-10 至奥珀卢瑟斯的 US 190。

timeline.en: A 32-mile segment is completed — the first stretch of I-49 anywhere in the country.
timeline.zh: 一段 32 英里道路建成，是全美最早的 I-49 路段。

timeline.en: Congress lists a Kansas City–New Orleans corridor as a high priority in ISTEA; it is later specified as I-49.
timeline.zh: 国会在《多式联运地面运输效率法》中把一条堪萨斯城—新奥尔良走廊列为高优先级，后明确编为 I-49。

timeline.en: The 212-mile route is completed on 1 May with the opening of the Martin Luther King Jr. Highway through Alexandria.
timeline.zh: 5 月 1 日，随着穿越亚历山德里亚的马丁·路德·金大道通车，212 英里的路线全线贯通。

timeline.en: I-49 opens north from Shreveport toward the Arkansas state line.
timeline.zh: I-49 自什里夫波特向北通往阿肯色州界的路段通车。
